name: feature.production.agents
description: Production Intelligence agent pack — the Production Planner, a manifest agent whose tools are the host-registered openwop:production.* agent tools (get-vendors read + plan action) over the Production surface. It reads the Vendor Directory to ground its recommendations and ignites a run that generates + persists a per-asset production plan (internal/contractor/agency/hybrid with budget & timeline) from the AI chat. Tool-allowlisted to the Production surface only.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Production Planner
agents.description: Recommends how each campaign asset should be produced — internal team, contractor, agency, or hybrid — with budget and timeline, ranking your team and vendors by channel fit. Reads the Vendor Directory and ignites a run that generates the plan via the openwop:production.* tools. Recommends; the human approves the plan.
